description:
Get organization payment method

Reports whether the selected organization has a card on file, its documented payment-method metadata, whether a purchase needs a card first (purchaseRefusal), and how it pays: by card, or by invoice on its contract's terms (agreement). Reading this endpoint does not collect a new card or create a checkout session.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/get-organization-payment-method
name: getOrganizationPaymentMethod

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: How the organization pays: self_serve by card, each purchase paid when made; enterprise by invoice on its contract's terms, its purchases added to its next monthly invoice.

paymentTermDays.description: Days from an invoice's issue to its due date: Net 30 is 30, and 0 is due on receipt.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: Printed on every invoice; null when the contract sets none.

cardOnFile.description: True once a card is captured for the payer.

paymentMethod.description: Metadata for the default card, or null.

purchaseRefusal.description: Why the organization can't pay for a purchase now, or null when it can. payment_method_required: add a card first; an organization that pays by invoice never needs one. billing_not_ready: its billing is still being set up; try again shortly. Decide purchases on this, not on cardOnFile.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["payment_method_required","billing_not_ready"]. Others may be added.

title: Get organization payment method
